item: audit Portal_ pad suffixes against ZoneGate ZONE_REGION keys: classify each pad TINTS / SILENT-NO-TINT / NOT-A-GATE, fix one-line mismatches only
note: 18 pads total, all from the single creation site init.server.luau:118 (rbxlx has 0 baked Portal_ instances). 11 wave pads TINT: WAVE[].name and ZONE_REGION keys are diff-identical lists and both sides sanitize with the same gsub(%W,_) (client init.client.luau:116, server ZoneGate.luau:55-58), so every wave pad joins by construction. 0 SILENT-NO-TINT. 7 climb pads (SWARM, RUINS GO, ARRAKIS, SKI, LIGHT MAZE, THE ANSWER, THE OSSUARY) are NOT-A-GATE by design: no ZONE_REGION row, portalGate returns true (ZoneGate.luau:99-101), no Gate_ attribute stamped (:133-135), client documents them staying untouched (init.client.luau:106-107).
